title: Odd predivision-polynomial vanishing detects affine torsion
statement: Let F be a characteristic-zero field with decidable equality, and let W be a Weierstrass equation over F with W.Δ ≠ 0. For every odd natural number n ≥ 3 and every nonsingular affine point (x,y) of W, the point represented by (x,y) is killed by n if and only if (W.preΨ' n).eval x = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (F : Type) [Field F] [CharZero F] [DecidableEq F] (W : WeierstrassCurve F), W.Δ ≠ 0 → ∀ (n : ℕ), 3 ≤ n → Odd n → ∀ (x y : F) (h : W.toAffine.Nonsingular x y), n • WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Point.some x y h = 0 ↔ (W.preΨ' n).eval x = 0
